quote: Through this agreement, GE Vernova plans to bring 1 gigawatt of new reliable power online within the first 24 months, in addition to 5 gigawatts over the following four years, significantly expanding Venezuela’s power capacity. The agreement will address thermal and hydroelectric power generation, transmission and distribution infrastructure, and key substations.
note: Opened DOE English fact sheet 2026-10-04; 1 GW/24mo + 5 GW/4yr and CORPOELEC framework confirmed; CapEx undisclosed.
